preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The lengths of strings S and A must be between 1 and 100000.
The lengths of the input strings S and A must match the specified lengths N and M.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'?', 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'} for c in S)
preconditions.description: String S must only contain characters from the set {'?', 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'}.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'} for c in A)
preconditions.description: String A must only contain characters from the set {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'}.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout) == N and all(c in {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'} for c in stdout))
postconditions.description: The output must either be -1 or a string of length N containing only characters from the set {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'}.

postconditions.expression: not any(A in stdout[i:] for i in range(len(stdout) - M + 1))
postconditions.description: The string A must not be a subsequence of the output string S'.
